scope: Current-geometry carrier compaction screening; no accepted smaller layout
motivation: The previous unpinned-pilot campaign predates current-pose escape reservations, smaller reference outline and subsequent search improvements. Test individual and combined search restrictions on the actual current implementation rather than infer feasibility from the old campaign.
base_command: native/build/fast/schgen_compact_stage_profile --repo . --project carrier --compact-search on --edge-feasibility on --owned-quality-first on --owned-face-cohesion on --contract-group-face-sheet usb_jtag --contract-group-face-sheet power --require-bottom-sheet power_mon --require-bottom-sheet bringup_modules --require-bottom-sheet bringup_en_modules --joint-separation-states 1024 --reseat-poses 8 --reseat-frontier 4096 --reseat-continuations 3 --reseat-victim-shapes on --owned-shape board_aux=owned-face-a1.000000 --owned-shape bringup_rails=bottom-a2.2/r270/owned-pins-forward --schematic carrier/Zynq_Carrier.kicad_sch --runs 1 --interior-order 3 --failed-first-retry on --shape-area-first on --floorplan-spec /private/tmp/carrier-next-outlines.QKynPr/163x150.json
spec_reconstruction: native/benchmarks/carrier-163x151-authored-proximity.floorplan.json with outline.h=150; comment changed to Unqualified next-height screen.
all_results: construction_failed; failure receipt captured, no acceptance or geometric infeasibility claim
observations: Individual and combined pilot pin releases preserve the baseline failure fallback event sequence exactly. This does not establish that these restrictions are harmless for every strategy or outline.
Selection trace has no board_aux or bringup_rails entries. It only reports multi-hit selections, so absence alone is not proof a block was never visited.

The first traced power decision chooses a 47.6904x23.9349 top offer while a 53.3604x23.9349 bottom offer exists. The local area heuristic can prefer a smaller top envelope despite bottom-side capacity; the forced-bottom control still fails, so that choice alone is not the solution.
Bottom-power control includes failed FMC reseats against power and HDMI termination. Failures describe this bounded strategy, not an inherent electrical relationship or impossible board geometry.
next_direction: Investigate early placement continuation feasibility and FMC/USB-JTAG remaining translation domains, including joint side/shape/pose changes, instead of further tuning the later pilot pins alone.
qualification: No expensive full builds or renders were run for failed candidates. Qualified 163x151 carrier and master release are preserved.
timing_caveat: Sequential single-run screening, uncontrolled OS cache; timings describe failed-search cost, not successful build performance or comparison to historical Python.
